pattern: asked to check with another bot, the bot writes into that bot's thread
experience: Peter asked his bot Jarvis to ask Ledger, a sibling bot. Jarvis sent into Ledger's main conversation with the thread tools, so the message read as Peter's, Ledger answered Peter instead of Jarvis, and neither conversation folded the talk into a bot exchange. Bots reach other bots with message_bot.

source.decision: Boops bot-to-bot messaging (2026-11-10): any bot a bot may reach is messaged with message_bot; thread writes into another bot's threads are refused.
